searches.question: What is the current compilation of the Cat Act 2011?
searches.route: WA Legislation landing page law_a146861.html (curl)
searches.note: Consolidated version 00-l0-01, currency start 25 Sep 2025, 'Current'; mrdoc_48898 (docx, pdf, htm). Landing page names the agency as the Department of Local Government, Industry Regulation and Safety.

searches.question: Are there other versions, and is 00-l0-01 the latest?
searches.route: law_a146861_currencies.html
searches.note: 12 consolidated versions from 00-a0-02 (9 Nov 2011) to 00-l0-01; 00-k0-00 ran 27 Aug 2022 to 24 Sep 2025.

searches.question: What amendments are incorporated and what is uncommenced?
searches.route: the compilation's endnotes (compilation and uncommenced provisions tables) and the history table law_a146861_table1.docx
searches.note: Incorporated: Public Health (Consequential Provisions) Act 2016 Pt 3 Div 7; Local Government Legislation Amendment Act 2019 Pt 4 Div 2; Veterinary Practice Act 2021 s 228; Dog Amendment (Stop Puppy Farming) Act 2021 ss 49 and 62. Uncommenced: Stop Puppy Farming ss 50-61; Evidence Act 2025 s 492(1). The two sources disagree on the Evidence Act's commencement (compilation: 18 Sep 2027 per SL 2026/190; history table: to be proclaimed); resolved by SRCH-07.

searches.question: What regulations are made under the Act, and their current compilations?
searches.route: law_a146861_subsidiary.html, then law_s44749 and law_s45694 landing and currency pages, and the Act + subsidiary Atom feed
searches.note: In force: Cat Regulations 2012 (02-b0-00, currency start 24 Jul 2025) and Cat (Uniform Local Provisions) Regulations 2013 (00-a0-05, currency start 1 Nov 2013). Nine amending regulations 2013-2022 listed as made, all marked 'Unavailable' for download; their effect is in the compilations. No other instrument (orders, notices) is listed under the Act.

searches.question: Has anything amended the Cat Regulations since the current compilation?
searches.route: subsidiary legislation as made, 2025 and 2026 listings (asmade_2025.html, asmade_2026.html), filtered for Cat, Dog, Evidence
searches.note: SL 2025/138 (already in 02-b0-00) is the latest. Nothing in 2026 amends either Cat regulation. A Ministerial Gazette notice of registration-tag colours under r 15(3) was not searched for.

searches.question: What do the uncommenced Stop Puppy Farming provisions say, and have any been proclaimed since?
searches.route: Acts as passed 2021 (aspassed_2021.html) -> mrdoc_44478; subsidiary legislation as made 2022-2026 filtered for 'Puppy'
searches.note: Proclamations: SL 2022/150 (not downloadable; per the endnotes it commenced Cat Act ss 49 and 62) and SL 2024/241 (Dog Act provisions only). Cat Act amendments ss 50-61 remain uncommenced.

searches.question: What does Evidence Act 2025 s 492(1) do to the Cat Act, and when does it commence?
searches.route: Acts as passed 2025 -> mrdoc_48825; law_a147490 landing and history table; asmade_2026 -> SL 2026/190
searches.note: s 492(1) Table replaces 'Evidence Act 1906' in Cat Act s 75(3). SL 2026/190 commences it on 18 Sep 2027. The Evidence Act's own history table lags the proclamation.

searches.question: Is any Bill amending the Cat Act currently before Parliament? (legislation site)
searches.route: PCO Table 11, 'Legislation amended by Bills currently in Parliament', via tablesbills.html
searches.note: Last updated 17 Sep 2026. Two Bills: No. 40-1 and No. 53-1. Acts as passed 2026 lists no Cat amendment Act.

searches.question: Is any Bill amending the Cat Act currently before Parliament? (Parliament)
searches.route: parliament.wa.gov.au bills database: WebCurrentBills?ReadViewEntries&ExpandView (XML) and WebAllBills?SearchView&Query=Cat, with a browser User-Agent
searches.note: The current-bills page renders its list by script, so the Domino ReadViewEntries/SearchView routes were used. Contrary to expectation, parliament.wa.gov.au served the bills pages and $File attachments to curl with a browser User-Agent; only Hansard was refused (SRCH-15). Both Bills confirmed, both at Legislative Council second reading.

searches.question: Bill 53-1 documents: prints, EMs, blue bill, messages
searches.route: BillProgressPopup for ParentUNID 0267E3C49F8D5B6448258DA800209A4F and its $File links
searches.note: 'As introduced' (Bill+053-1.pdf) and 'as passed by originating House' (Bill+53-1.pdf) are byte-identical, so the Bill passed the Assembly unamended or the page links the same file twice. LA message 78 is a scan with no text layer. No LC Supplementary Notice Paper file was linked.

searches.question: Bill 40-1 documents
searches.route: BillProgressPopup for ParentUNID 87C43A57E2A70C3248258D080081B074

searches.question: Cat Bill 2011: Bill as passed, explanatory memoranda, amendments
searches.route: BillProgressPopup for ParentUNID F86394C3FA4A36BB482578B0001AFF0F (the landing page's 'Bill Information' link)
searches.note: The LA and LC EM links are byte-identical. No 'Related Committee Activity'. The three messages (Gov 29, LC 184, Gov 41 of 2011) were not downloaded. Bill as introduced (197-1) is not linked on the page and was not found.

searches.question: Explanatory memoranda of the Bills that amended the Cat Act
searches.route: WebAllBills?SearchView for Stop Puppy Farming, Local Government Legislation Amendment, Public Health Consequential, Veterinary Practice, 'Evidence Bill 2025'; then each BillProgressPopup
searches.note: The originating-House EM of each was downloaded; each Bill page also lists a second EM, not downloaded. Second-reading speeches for these Bills were not sought (Hansard refuses; SRCH-15).

searches.question: Cat Bill 2011 second-reading speeches (LA 15 Jun 2011, LC 21 Sep 2011)
searches.route: Hansard PDF links on the bill page, by curl with a browser User-Agent
searches.note: HTTP 403, Azure WAF ('Please enable JavaScript'). Recorded as hansard-la-2r-cat-bill-2011 and hansard-lc-2r-cat-bill-2011, not retrieved.

searches.question: Cat Bill 2011 second-reading speech, by browser
searches.route: in-app browser pane, navigate to the LA Hansard PDF
searches.note: The page showed a Microsoft 'checking you're not a bot' interstitial. Not pursued: completing or waiting out bot detection is outside what the agent may do. Left for 3H.

searches.question: Second-reading speeches for Bills 53 and 40
searches.route: hansard/daily/lh/2026-02-25/8, hansard/daily/uh/2026-09-16/44, hansard/daily/uh/2025-09-18/7, and hansard/search (curl)
searches.note: HTTP 403 on all four. Recorded as hansard-2r-bill-53 and hansard-2r-bill-40, not retrieved.

searches.question: Committee reports on the Act or its regulations
searches.route: web search ('Joint Standing Committee on Delegated Legislation report cat local law Western Australia'), then parliament.wa.gov.au WCurrentCommitteesByName -> Delegated Legislation Committee page
searches.note: JSCDL Report 1 of the 42nd Parliament (Bayswater cats local law, 11 Sep 2025). Partial: only the current committee page was read; reports of the 41st Parliament and earlier (the EM to Bill 53 refers to a longer-held JSCDL view, and press reports describe 2022-2023 undertakings by the City of Bayswater) were not searched. No committee activity is recorded against the Cat Bill 2011, Bill 53 or Bill 40.

searches.question: Statutory review under s 86: reports
searches.route: web search ('Cat Act 2011 statutory review report section 86'; 'Review of the Cat Act 2011 report'), DLGSC review page, wa.gov.au publication page
searches.note: First review report (2019) found on wa.gov.au. Second review: consultation by LGIRS closed 31 Aug 2026 (DLGSC page reviewed 13 Feb 2026); no report yet. The tabled-paper version on Parliament's site was not looked for.

searches.question: Texts of provisions the reference register supplies as facts: Veterinary Practice Act 2021 s 3
searches.route: aspassed_2021 -> law_a147315 landing page -> mrdoc_48936
searches.note: Veterinary Practice Act 2021 compilation 00-f0-01 (currency start 25 Sep 2025) downloaded, held and its s 3 definitions read. The references to it are supplied as facts; the text is held so 3H can check that. Not fetched (references supplied as facts or out of scope): Dog Act 1976, Animal Welfare Act 2002, Public Health Act 2016, Vocational Education and Training Act 1996, Rates and Charges (Rebates and Deferments) Act 1992, Oaths, Affidavits and Statutory Declarations Act 2005, Biosecurity Act 2015 (Cth), Police Act 1892. Interpretation Act 1984 and Local Government Act 1995 are in the 0H reference set and were not gathered again.

searches.question: Licence terms of each source
searches.route: legislation.wa.gov.au copyright.html; parliament.wa.gov.au copyright page; notices inside each document (grep for copyright / Creative Commons)
searches.note: Legislation website: CC BY 4.0, and every compilation and as-made instrument carries its own notice except the 2013 ULP compilation and the history tables (site licence). Parliament site: non-commercial terms, tabled papers excluded; no Bill or EM carries a notice except the Bill 53 blue bill (CC BY) and the Veterinary Practice EM (DPIRD copyright). 2019 review report: all rights reserved.
